title: Steam (Windows client in a bottle; fallback only)
description: Fallback B of the Witcher 3 pipeline: the Windows Steam client inside its own bottle, for when steamcmd and DepotDownloader are both out. Mirrors what CodeWeavers' Steam CrossTie (cxversion 26) sets up: a win10 64-bit bottle, Core Fonts + the latest VC++ runtime (x64 and x86) + d3dcompiler_47 (both bitnesses), MSync on, and WINE_WAIT_CHILD_PIPE_IGNORE=steam.exe (REA L-69, L-34). ossover downloads no installer; run SteamSetup.exe yourself with `ossover run`. Do not apply this to the witcher3 bottle.

steps.note: The CX Steam tie's dependencies (L-69): Core Fonts, VC++ latest x64 + x86 (vcrun2022 installs both bitnesses in one verb), d3dcompiler_47 for both bitnesses. Needs cabextract (brew install cabextract); the Asian Fonts dependency is not carried over.

steps.text: Install the client yourself: download SteamSetup.exe from store.steampowered.com on the Mac, then run `ossover run --bottle <bottle> 'Z:\Users\<you>\Downloads\SteamSetup.exe'`. ossover never downloads installers.

For The Witcher 3: Library > The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt > Properties > Betas > select `next-gen` (4.04, DirectX 11 exe); under Launch Options add `--launcher-skip -skipStartScreen`. Turn off automatic updates for the game so Steam cannot move it to the DX12-only 5.x Remastered.
Sync is msync, as CrossOver does for every Steam install (the tie pulls in 'Enable MSync', L-34); an engine without msync gets `none` from WineEnvironment.effectiveSync.

WINE_WAIT_CHILD_PIPE_IGNORE=steam.exe is set on CX-derived engines only (the msync capability is the proxy): its readers are in the CrossOver tree's ntdll (src:dlls/ntdll/unix/server.c:1758-1776, process.c:477, 2343) and no upstream reader is known. The tie sets it as installerenvironment; ossover keeps it in the bottle because it does not run the installer itself.
CEF_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 and LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 are ossover-specific: the CX Steam tie sets neither (L-69) and CrossOver never sets a global LC_ALL (L-14).

knownIssues.symptom: Steam window is blank or the login page never renders
knownIssues.cause: Chromium Embedded Framework sandbox cannot start under Wine
knownIssues.fix: CEF_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 (set by this recipe); restart the bottle with `ossover bottle stop` then run again.

knownIssues.symptom: Login hangs after the credentials are accepted
knownIssues.cause: Engines whose kernelbase.dll was built with llvm-mingw stall Steam's login (frankea/winecx-gptk bisect)
knownIssues.fix: Use an ossover engine built with mingw-w64 GCC, or the bootstrap engine.

knownIssues.symptom: Garbled or missing text in the client
winetricks fails at once with 'cabextract not found'
knownIssues.cause: Core Fonts and d3dcompiler_47 are cab archives; winetricks needs cabextract to unpack them
knownIssues.fix: brew install cabextract, then apply again.
